हिङ्कृ हिङ्कृ, cl. 8. 5. P. -करोति, -कृणोति,
&c., to make the sound हिम्; to low (as a cow).
—हिङ्-कार, अस्, m. the sound हिम्; a kind of low
roar; a tiger (as making this sound).
—हिङ्-कृण्-
वत्, अन्, अती, अत्, Ved. making the sound हिम्;
roaring (as a tiger); lowing (as of a cow; Sāy. हिङ्-
कृण्वती = वत्सम् प्रति हिङ्कारं कुर्वती, Ṛg-
veda

हिङ्गु हिङ्गु, उस्, उ, m. n. (according to
Uṇādi-s.

. fr. हि, substituted for rt. 1. हन्;
according to Śabda-k. only neut.), the plant Asa
Fetida (said to be so called as ‘killing’ or over-
powering all other odours); the substance prepared
from the plant (for household use).
—हिङ्गु-ना-
डिका, f. the resin of a particular plant (= नाडी-
हिङ्गु).
—हिङ्गु-निर्यास, अस्, m. the gummy exu-
dation or concrete juice of Asa Fetida; the Nimba
tree.
—हिङ्गु-पत्त्र, अस्, m. the Iṅgudī tree; (ई),
f. a drug composed of a leaf resembling that of Asa
Fetida; (अम्), n. the leaf of the Asa Fetida plant.
—हिङ्गु-पर्णी, f. a particular plant (= वंश-
पत्त्री).
—हिङ्गु-शिराटिका, f. a kind of plant (=
वंश-पत्त्री).

हिङ्गुल, अस्, अम्, m. n. a preparation of mercury
with sulphur, vermilion; (आ), f., N. of a country
(mentioned in the Vāmana-Purāṇa); N. of a goddess.
—हिङ्गुला-जा, f., N. of a goddess.

हिङ्गूल, अम्, n. a kind of edible root like a
potato, a sort of yam (= आलु).
हिङ्गुली, f. the egg-plant, Solanum Melongena.

हिङ्गुलिका, f. the prickly nightshade, Solanum
Jacquini.
हिङ्गुलु, उस्, उ, m. n. vermilion.
